title: Screen Recorder Video Recorder
summary: Screen recorder with audio & high-quality screen capture for gameplay.
description:
Level up your screen recordings with Screen Recorder Video Recorder - Recordify, an all-in-one screen recording and video editing tool. Capture high-quality videos, create helpful tutorials, record gameplay, and save memorable video calls where recording is permitted. From clear screen recording to simple video editing, Recordify has you covered.

🔥Transform Your Screen into a Studio:

- High-Quality Recording: Record your screen in 1080P, 16 Mbps, and up to 120 FPS on supported devices.
- Clear Audio Recording: Record device audio, microphone audio, or both. Device audio only for Android 10+.
- Quick Screenshots: Capture important moments instantly while recording.
- Built-in Video Editor: Trim, crop, and rotate your recordings to create polished, share-ready videos.
- Video to GIF: Turn your favorite video moments into smooth, shareable GIFs.
- Facecam Recording with Audio: Add a Facecam window and your voice to tutorials, reactions, presentations, and gameplay recordings.
- Live Drawing & Annotation: Use the Brush tool to draw, highlight, and explain content directly on your screen while recording.
- Easy Export & Sharing: Save your recordings to your device and share them through the system share menu.

📱Intuitive Recording Controls:

- Floating Ball Control: Start, pause, resume, stop, or screenshot with a single touch on the floating ball.
- Quick Recording Controls: Manage your recording without repeatedly returning to the app.
- Gesture Control: Customize supported gestures for faster access to common recording actions.
- No Preset Time Limit, No Watermark: Create longer recordings without an added Recordify watermark. Recording length may depend on available storage and device limitations.
- Customizable Settings: Adjust resolution, video quality, frame rate, orientation, audio source, and control preferences to suit your needs.

🚀More Than a Screen Recorder — Your Pocket Video Maker:

- Create Helpful Tutorials: Combine screen recording, clear audio, screenshots, and live drawing to explain each step visually.
- Capture Gameplay: Record gameplay and highlight memorable moments using quick screenshots and floating controls.
- Record with Camera & Audio: Add your reactions and commentary while recording supported on-screen content.
- Trim and Edit Videos: Remove unwanted sections, crop the frame, rotate videos, and prepare recordings for sharing.
- Save Important Moments: Record permitted video calls, live content, and other supported screen activities.
- Share with Ease: Export your finished videos and share them through compatible apps installed on your device.

Try Screen Recorder Video Recorder - Recordify and unlock your potential as a mobile video maker. Start creating and sharing your story!

➡️Contact Us:
The Recordify team values your feedback. Contact us at screenrecorder.feedback@gmail.com.

Important Notes:
* Please grant the permissions required for the features you choose to use.
* Recording quality, frame rate, device audio, and Facecam availability may vary by device, Android version, and the app being recorded.
* Some apps and protected content may restrict screen recording, screenshots, or internal audio capture.
* Only record, edit, and share content that you own or have permission to use.
* Users are responsible for complying with applicable laws, third-party terms, copyright requirements, and consent requirements.
* Please review our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use before using the app.
